_documentation: Ledger for the social-publishing pipeline (scripts/social-post.py, issue #1072). `posted` holds the dedup keys of items already published (news::<id>, spotlight::<slug>::<isoweek>, thread::<slug>), so re-runs publish nothing. The news key is the news.json item id (the <guid>), not the link, so two items pointing at the same page do not collide. The pipeline appends here after a successful post; the spotlight key includes the ISO week so a member is posted at most once per week. Do not hand-edit unless re-publishing an item on purpose. Seeded with the four news items already live so activation does not re-announce history; a news item can also opt out via its `social` field ("skip" or "thread:<slug>") rather than the ledger.
